name: Rotten Dollhart
original_name: ロッテン・ドールハート
source:
"I'm Rottie! Let's be friends!

A girl living at the girls' dormitory in Liz Shoara. Her nickname is Rot (Rottie in the English version). A noble girl with a cheerful and kind personality, she is looked up to by all the other girls at the dormitory. She is caring and full of curiosity, and will poke her head at any mystery she comes across. Her personality is extreme and she is somewhat detached from the real world, sometimes showing a natural airheadedness.

She is the type of character who will let anyone into her heart, so she repeatedly attacks and hounds newcomer [url=/c87471]Mai[/url] with all of her might. Soon enough, Mai begins to open up her heart to her and they eventually become close friends.
